-- True when `name` can be read as a file inside `notes`.
-- Missing, unreadable or escaping names (e.g. "../x", "/etc/passwd") are not readable.
-- The read happens only under `fs.sub("notes")`, so no name can reach outside it.
is_readable(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  ex is_readable("../secret") == False
  ex is_readable("/etc/passwd") == False
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return False
    return True
  False

-- Counts the names that are readable files inside `notes`.
-- Confinement to `notes` is done inside `is_readable`.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["../secret", "/etc/passwd"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if is_readable(name)
      n += 1
  n
